summary: Tested real Twilio masked SMS + phone editing (backend + frontend 390x844) plus a quick check of signature/complete drop. Exactly 2 real SMS were sent (1 from pytest, 1 from the UI tap on sms-preset-0), both to the seeded fictional number +14155551000/+14155550123. Twilio returned 201 with status 'queued' and an SM… sid each time. CALL was NOT triggered against any assigned stop. The only call request tested was on an unassigned stop, which returns 400 'Driver phone…' before Twilio is ever reached. Backend: 24 passed, 1 skipped (the real-send test was skipped on the full rerun so no third SMS went out). Frontend: all requested flows pass. One pre-existing frontend bug: SignaturePad calls the parent's setState from inside a state updater. This logs a React error, and the dev LogBox toast it creates covers the COMPLETE DROP button on web.

minor.issue: Success means Twilio 'queued', not delivered. +1415555xxxx numbers are fictional, so these texts will likely end up undelivered on Twilio's side. There is no status callback, so the UI always says 'TEXT SENT'.

twilio.http_client logs every request at INFO level, including the full POST URL with the Account SID. The auth token is not logged. Suggest logging.getLogger('twilio.http_client').setLevel(logging.WARNING).
There is no rate limit or debounce on the server. Repeated CALL taps would each place a separate real Twilio call.

ui_bugs.issue: onFinalize calls onChange (parent setState) inside the setCurrent updater, which raises the React error 'Cannot update a component (StopDetail) while rendering a different component (SignaturePad)'. On web dev the LogBox toast sits over the bottom CTA and blocks taps on COMPLETE DROP (Playwright clicks were swallowed; the drop only completed via dispatch_event). Fix: keep the current stroke in a useRef and call onChange outside the updater. Reference: /app/frontend/src/components/SignaturePad.tsx:17-21

There is no in-flight/loading state, so tapping repeatedly fires several real Twilio calls. Add a sending state and disable the button while the request runs. Reference: /app/frontend/app/driver/stop/[stopId].tsx:52-60,149

issues: The shared 'busy' state means saving numbers also turns MARK ARRIVED and COMPLETE DROP into spinners. Use a separate savingPhones state.
savePhones is not atomic: if the customer phone saves and the driver phone then fails, the customer change stays saved while a red toast is shown.
'NUMBERS MASKED VIA TWILIO LINE' label is 10px muted text, which is hard to read.

action_items: Fix SignaturePad setState-in-render (use a ref for the current stroke and call onChange directly in onFinalize).
Add an in-flight guard/loading state to the CALL (and SMS) contact actions to prevent duplicate paid Twilio requests.
Use a separate loading state for savePhones so the bottom CTA is unaffected.
Optional: lower the twilio.http_client log level, and add a Twilio status callback if delivery status matters.
critical_code_review_comments: Contact endpoint: validation order is good (channel, then stop 404, then E.164, then driver present before any Twilio call). TwilioRestException is mapped to 502. _id is excluded.
Call TwiML: the customer name is xml-escaped, and the customer phone is E.164-validated before it goes into <Dial>. Fine.
The old backend_test.py contact test sent channel 'call' (it would ring a real phone). It has been replaced with an invalid-channel 400 test.
backend_test.py had a hardcoded default BASE_URL, now removed (env var only).

success_rate.frontend: 100% of requested flows (SMS presets/toast, edit numbers valid/invalid, signature + complete drop); LogBox overlay issue noted

seed_data_creation: None. Ran POST /api/admin/reset at the end to restore seeded phones.
context_for_next_testing_agent: REAL Twilio: run pytest with SKIP_TWILIO_SEND=1 to avoid paid SMS. Run serially with `-n 0` (both test modules call admin/reset). Never send channel 'call' to an assigned stop. Toast testID='toast'. Signature drawing: scroll with mouse.wheel(0,350), draw with mouse; LogBox may cover the CTA, so use dispatch_event('click') on complete-drop-button.
